card.name: Small words in injection diluent descriptions
card.fires_on: Small linking words or punctuation (a, an, as, high, comma, open parenthesis) inside injection preparation text. They sit right after a diluent or preservative name such as benzyl alcohol or Sodium Chloride Injection.

modes.label: Preservative phrasing
modes.description: The word a or as right after benzyl alcohol, introducing preservative.
modes.example: containing 1.1% benzyl alcohol as<< a>> preservative to yield a multiple-dose

modes.label: After diluent name
modes.description: A comma or parenthesis right after a diluent name like Injection, USP or 0.9%.
modes.example: of diluent to drug volume) of 0.9% Sodium Chloride Injection<<,>> USP; 0.45

modes.label: Property adjectives
modes.description: The word high or an before a property such as pH, density or osmolality.
modes.example: For<< high>> density medication such as potassium chloride, squeeze
